Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.

entry.content: ... that the white ring on the flag of Okinawa Prefecture (pictured) represents the "O" in "Okinawa"?

entry.content: ... that Emirati princess Mahra Al Maktoum invoked the triple talaq to divorce her husband, which is traditionally done only by the husband?

entry.title: prisoners of war in World War II (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that as many as 35 million soldiers became prisoners of war in World War II, according to some estimates?

entry.content: ... that Luigi Mangione was described as "somewhat of an online sex symbol" following his December 2024 arrest?

entry.title: Mseilha Fort (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the Mseilha Fort is strategically located to overlook the crossing of the Jaouz River near Ras ash-Shaq'a, a promontory in Lebanon?

entry.title: Saint Amata of Assisi (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that Saint Amata of Assisi was interviewed and testified during the process of the canonization of her aunt, Saint Clare of Assisi?

entry.title: the school's TV station (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that journalism students at New Mexico State University were willing to work for free to save their newscast on the school's TV station?

entry.title: Rockwell PPS-8 (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that the Rockwell PPS-8 microprocessor had a number of features that made Adam Osborne call it "most unusual" and "difficult to understand"?

entry.title: a president of the Oregon Senate (Wikipedia — did you know?)
entry.content: ... that a president of the Oregon Senate crawled along a ledge of the State Capitol to access an unsecured window of the absent governor's office to place bills on his desk?
